SELECT feed.task_code, MAX(task.mat_code) as productCode, MAX(task.mat_name) as productName, produceTask.route_code, MAX(produceTask.route_name) as route_name, feed.mat_code, MAX(feed.mat_name) as mat_name, MAX(feed.mat_spec) as mat_spec, feed.mat_batch as batchNo, MAX(feed.mat_unit) as mat_unit, MAX(feed.status) as status, (SUM(COALESCE(feed.feed_num, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(feed.used_num, 0))) as leftNum, MAX(feed.update_time) as lastUsedTime, MAX(feed.is_lock) as is_lock, MAX(feed.factory_code) as factory_code FROM mes_warehouse_feed feed LEFT JOIN mes_task task on feed.task_code = task.code LEFT JOIN mes_produce_task produceTask on feed.produce_task_code = produceTask.code

AND feed.task_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.taskCode}, '%')
